intro: In informative texts, the agent can be omitted with строится, построили or построено; each form focuses process, action or result.

bloques.titulo: In informative texts, the agent can be omitted with строится, построили or построено; each form focuses process, action or result.
texto: In informative texts, the agent can be omitted with строится, построили or построено; each form focuses process, action or result.
They do not always amount to the Spanish passive: it identifies whether the text highlights the process, the result or who acted.

frases.es: Están construyendo un nuevo centro médico en el distrito.
frases.en: They're building a new medical center in the district.

frases.ru: Новое здание было открыто в прошлом году.
frases.es: El nuevo edificio se inauguró el año pasado.
frases.en: The new building was opened last year.

bloques.pregunta: What sentence does the process in progress present?

opciones.explicacion: Строят presents an ongoing action with unspecified agent.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
Check which word rules the case or the structure.

opciones.texto: They're building a new medical center in the district.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: The new building was opened last year.
opciones.explicacion: That's the translation of the second example.

bloques.frase: Новое здание было открыто в прошлом году
bloques.traduccion: The new building was opened last year.
bloques.explicacion: Look at the order of words and the outstanding grammatical form.
